t: Din hammaplig bispina vehaholek beshayyara beshabbat
s: Din hammaplig bispina vehaholek beshayyara beshabbat ubo y"d seipim: en mapligim bispina beyammim hammeluchim pachot mig' yamim meet leet qodem hashshabbat, dehaynu miyyom d' veelak, veyom d' biklal haissur, lepi shekkol hammapligim beyammim hammeluchim yesh lahem bekol g' yamim harishonim tzaar ubilbul veshinnuy veset, vegupam mishtabber minninua hassepina, veen rucham chozeret ad leachar shelosha yamim meet leet, veim yaplig pachot mig' yamim qodem hashshabbat — lo yihyeh lo oneg beshabbat. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmaplig lidbar hareshut, abal lidbar mitzva muttar lehaplig apillu beereb shabbat, ap al pi shello yihyeh lo oneg beshabbat, lepi shehaoseq bemitzva patur mimmitzva acheret. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla yipsoq im hannokri hammolik hassepina sheyyishbot velo yolikenna beshabbat, veim achar kak eno shobet — en bekak kelum. Veim i epshar lo lipsoq immo, sheggam akshav omer shello yishbot beshabbat — yesh omerim sheasur lo lehaplig ad leachar hashshabbat. (Umikkol maqom, im yesh chashash shettitbattel hammitzva sheholek eleha mechamat ichur darko — yesh lehaqel. Veken im i epshar beqal limtzo sepina leachar hashshabbat lehaplig bah — yesh lehaqel bishat haddechaq):

Veim hu derek muat, kegon mitztzor letzidon, sheen sham ella mahalak yom echad kesheharuach tob — muttar lehaplig apillu lidbar hareshut beereb shabbat babboqer, lepi sheepshar sheyyihyeh ruach tob veyaggiu lesham qodem hallayla. Ubemaqom shennahagu shello lehaplig beereb shabbat kelal apillu derek muat — asur lahem leshannot mehamminhag, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman ts"ch ubeyoreh dea simman ry"d:

Vekol zeh beyammim, abal binharot kevan sheen shum tzaar lehammapligin bahen — muttar lehaplig bahem apillu beereb shabbat bekol inyan im hassepina holeket bishbil nokrim. Veap al pi sheholek beshabbat kamma parsaot — en bezeh mishshum issur techumin apillu lehaomerim ditchum y"b mil hu min hattora, shenneemar "al yetze ish mimmeqomo", dehaynu mimmachaneh yisrael shehayeta y"b mil, mikkol maqom keshemmehallek al pene hammayim — en bezeh issur min hattora, kevan sheeno domeh lemachaneh yisrael shehayeta bayyabbasha. Veap al pi sheal kol panim yesh issur techumin bemayim middibre soperim, mikkol maqom im hassepina mehalleket lemala mi' tepachim miqqarqa hannahar — en bezeh issur apillu middibre soperim, lepi sheyyesh sapeq im yesh issur techumin lemala mi' tepachim apillu bey"b mil bayyabbasha, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"d, vekevan sheal pene hammayim en issur techumin apillu y"b mil ella middibre soperim ledibre hakkol, im ken hare zeh sepeq dibre soperim, sheholekin bo lehaqel bekol maqom. Abal im hassepina mehalleket lematta mi' tepachim, dehaynu sheen y' tepachim mayim mittachat shule hassepina ad qarqait hannahar — asur lelek bah beshabbat chutz lattechum, apillu niknas lassepina shelosha yamim qodem hashshabbat, dehaynu millel rebii bashshabbat veelak, vaapillu im hassepina meshuqqaat harbeh bammayim beinyan sheetzel dopneha yesh bammayim omeq y' tepachim vetachat shuleha en sham y' tepachim — hare zeh asur, apillu im hu yosheb lemala beinyan shemmimmeqom yeshibato yesh yoter mi' tepachim. Veyesh mattirin keshehu yosheb lemala mi' tepachim veen raglayv teluyot letok matta mi' tepachim, im hassepina mehalleket lemala mig' tepachim, veen issur ella kesheyyosheb al shule hassepina veen meal shuleha ad haqqarqa y' tepachim, o sheyyosheb al dabar acher veen meal oto dabar ad haqqarqa y' tepachim. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem keshetztzarik lekak:

Veim hu mesuppaq im hi mehalleket lemala mi' tepachim o lematta mi' tepachim — hare zeh muttar, shekkol sheyyesh sapeq bedibre soperim holekin lehaqel, veen tzarik lehachamir ella kesheyyadua beberur sheyyesh issur middibre soperim:

Veim niknas lassepina qodem g' yamim lipne hashshabbat, dehaynu bashshelishi bashshabbat o qodem leken — muttar lelek bah beshabbat chutz lattechum, ap im yadua lo shemmehalleket lematta mi' tepachim, o apillu lematta mig' tepachim, dekevan sheissur techumin eno ella middibrehem — lo ratzu lehachamir kol kak leesor keshenniknas lassepina qodem g' yamim, kevan shehu eno oseh kelum, vehassepina hi shemmolika oto michutz lattechum. Vaapillu im hu beinyan sheepshar sheyyitztarek hayyisrael lechallel shabbat beholakat hassepina, apillu bimlaka haasura min hattora, mippene piqquach nepesh — ap al pi ken muttar lo likkanes betokah qodem g' yamim, shehare akshav hu niknas behetter, ukesheyyaggia hashshabbat veyitztarek laasot melaka mippene piqquach nepesh — muttar hu, veen kan chillul. Abal tok g' yamim qodem shabbat — asur likkanes letokah, apillu im hi mehalleket lemala mi' tepachim im yodea sheyyitztarek lechallel shabbat mippene piqquach nepesh, apillu bedabar sheeno asur ella middibre soperim, lepi shennireh keniknas bekavvana limqom sakkana kede sheyyechallel shabbat achar kak. Umah sheen chosheshim lekak qodem g' yamim, hu, lepi sheg' yamim harishonim shebbashshabua hen niqraim yamim sheachar hashshabbat heabar, veenam mityachasim leshabbat habbaa, lepikak eno mechuyyab lizzaher bahem shello laasot bahem dabar sheyyodea sheyyitztarek achar kak lechallel shabbat habbaa, shekkesheyyaggia shabbat veyitztarek lechallelo mippene piqquach nepesh — muttar hu, veen kan chillul. Mah sheen ken beg' yamim haacharonim shebbashshabua shenniqraim yamim shellipne hashshabbat umityachasim leshabbat habbaa — mechuyyab hoa middibre soperim lehizzaher bahem shello laasot bahem dabar sheyyodea sheyyitztarek achar kak lechallel hashshabbat, shello yehe nireh keillu mitkavven baasiyyato kede lechallel hashshabbat achar kak:

Vaapillu im yadua lo shello yitztarek lechallel hashshabbat kelal, shehannokrim osim hakkol, mikkol maqom im iqqar hahalika shel hassepina hu bishbil yisrael, kegon sherubbah yisrael — asur likkanes betokah betok g' yamim shellipne hashshabbat, apillu im hi mehalleket lemala mi' tepachim, lepi shemmah shehannokrim oseqim beholakat hassepina beshabbat — yesh bazeh issur gamur (ap al pi shehem oseqim meatzmam belo amirat yisrael, vehem mitkavvenim letobatam leqabbel hassakar sheqqatzetzu lahem bead sheyyoliku otam limchoz cheptzam, vahare hem qabbelanim lekak, umuttar lehanniach leqabbelan sheyyaaseh melakto beshabbat, mikkol maqom kan) shehayyisrael neheneh beshabbat atzmah miggup hammelaka sheoseh hannokri bishbilo beshabbat — (hare kol hammelaka niqret al shem hayyisrael, sheap al pi shehannokri mitkavven kede sheyyaggia lo toba mizzeh, mikkol maqom kevan sheakshav bishat asiyyat hammelaka yesh leyisrael hanaa mimmenna — hare hi naaset bishbilo yoter mibbishbil hannokri, shehannokri gam ken mitkavven bishbil hayyisrael, ella sheoseh ken bead hassakar sheyyitten lo, veeno domeh leqabbelan hamtaqqen kelim leyisrael beshabbat, sheen hayyisrael neheneh beshabbat atzmah miggup melaka zo, ella leachar hashshabbat, kesheyyigmerem veyishtammesh bahem). Ulepikak, en hetter leolam lelek beshabbat bispina hamhalleket bishbil yisrael, ella shemmippene hassakkana muttar hu kevan shekkebar niknesu letokah, veim lo yeleku beshabbat yistakkenu, im ken en likkanes letokah ella qodem g' yamim shellipne hashshabbat, mittaam shennitbaer:

Vekol zeh kesheholek lidbar hareshut, abal lidbar mitzva muttar lehaplig apillu beereb shabbat, apillu bispina hamhalleket lematta mi' tepachim, apillu hu beinyan shekkesheyyaggia qarob lair epshar sheyyitztarek lelek chutz lattechum mippene hassakkana, vaapillu hassepina holeket bishbil yisrael, vaapillu yitztarek laasot melakot gemurot haasurot min hattora, dekevan sheakshav maplig behetter — lo gazeru chakamim kesheholek lidbar mitzva, ap sheyyitztarek achar kak lechallel shabbat mippene piqquach nepesh. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla yipsoq im hannokri sheyyishbot, velo yelek beshabbat keshello yihyeh az chashash sakkana baddabar, veim achar kak lo yishbot veyelek ap sheen chashash sakkana baddabar — en bekak kelum:

Abal lechallel shabbat letzorek mitzva, apillu bedabar sheen bo ella issur shebut middibre soperim — lo hittiru, ella im ken hu shebut dishbut, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"z. Lepikak, im en sham chashash sakkana kesheyyetze mehassepina velo yelek immahem chutz lattechum beshabbat — asur lo lehaplig bah lelek immahem gam beshabbat im hi mehalleket lematta mi' tepachim, ap al pi sheholek lidbar mitzva, ella im ken niknas letokah qodem g' yamim shellipne hashshabbat:

Veken asur lo likkanes bassepina beshabbat atzmah ap al pi sheholek lidbar mitzva, apillu mehalleket lemala mi' tepachim, vaapillu lelek letok hattechum, vaapillu hi mehalleket bishbil nokrim, lepi sheaseru likkanes kelal bispina beshabbat, apillu enah mehalleket kelal ella tzapa al pene hammayim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"t, lepi shennireh keillu hu atzmo tzap veshat al pene hammayim, veasur lashut beshabbat mishshum gezera shemma yaaseh chabit shel shayyatin shemmelammedin et atzman lashut bemayim al chabit. Abal keshenniknas lassepina meereb shabbat, ap al pi sheholeket gam beshabbat venireh keshat — lo gazeru chakamim, kevan shehu eno oseh kelum beshabbat, shemmeelayv hu shat al yede kenisato letokah meereb shabbat, shehi sheat hetter apillu laasot chabit shel shayyatin, ulepikak apillu im hi mapleget mehayyabbasha beshabbat atzmo — en bekak kelum, kevan shenniknas letokah meereb shabbat. Umikkol maqom, im yatza mimmenna layyabbasha — asur lo lachazor letokah beshabbat, lepi shebbiknisa zo shebbeshabbat yesh bah issur mishshum shat. Veyesh mattirin likkanes betokah ulehaplig beshabbat im qana bah shebita meereb shabbat, dehaynu shehaya betokah mittechillat ben hashshemashot ad shechoshka, dekevan shebbitchillat kenisat hashshabbat hayeta shebitato betokah — naaset hi kebeto, veap sheyyatza mimmenna achar kak veshaha harbeh bayyabbasha, vaapillu lan sham — lo hipsid bezeh shebitato shebbassepina, raq sheyyizzaher lachazor leotah sepina sheqqana bah shebita velo yikkanes lispina acheret. Veken nitpashshet hamminhag biqtzat meqomot, veen limchot beyadam, ap shehaiqqar kisbara harishona, kevan sheyyesh lahem al mi sheyyismeku. Umikkol maqom, leachar shehipliga chutz lattechum asurim latzet layyabbasha, apillu niknesa letok ir hammuqqepet choma ledira, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"h. Veyesh nohagin od lesadder shulchan bassepina ulehadliq sham nerot velaasot qiddush, kede sheyyitparsem lakkol sheqqanu bah shebita, velo yachshedu otam kesheyyapligu bah lemachar bayyom. Umikkol maqom, tzerikim lehizzaher sheyyeshebu sham bassepina kol ben hashshemashot ad shettechshak, velo yetzeu mimmenna kelal beemtza ben hashshemashot, shebbekol rega verega shebbeben hashshemashot yesh sapeq shemma hu techillat hallayla, uberega shel techillat hallayla tzarik lihyot bassepina, kemo shennitbaer:

Vaapillu im chal yom tob beereb shabbat yakol liqnot bo shebita, veen bezeh mishshum hakana. Veap im qana shebita beereb yom tob — enah moelet leshabbat shelleacharayv. Veken im qana shebita beereb shabbat — enah moelet leyom tob sheachar hashshabbat, vetzarik lachazor veliqnot shebita beben hashshemashot shel motzae shabbat leyom tob. Veken haddin beb' yamim tobim shel galuyyot. Abal beb' yamim tobim shel rosh hashshana — day bishbita sheqqana beereb yom tob harishon ap leyom tob hashsheni, kemo sheyyitbaer kol zeh besimman tt"z:

Vekol zeh keshemmaplig benahar vehassepina holeket bishbil nokrim umehalleket lemala mi' tepachim. Veap im molikim otah al yede behemot hamhallekim bispat hannahar — en bekak kelum, veeno domeh leqaron shemmolikim oto behemot, sheasur lehallek bo apillu betok hattechum, gezera shemma yachtok zemora lehanhig bah habbehemot, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"h, lepi shehayyosheb beqaron qarob hu etzel habbehemot, vederek hu shellipamim hu manhig habbehemot, abal hayyosheb bispina rachoq hu mibbehemot hamhallekot bispat hannahar umolikim et hassepina al yede chabalim arukkim, veen darko leolam lehanhig otan:

Ubemaqom shennahagu lehaplig ap beyammim hammeluchim (meereb shabbat, o apillu beshabbat al yede qeniyyat shebita meereb shabbat), im enam holekim letiyyul ella lischora, o lirot pene chaberehem — en limchot beyadam, lepi sheyyesh mi sheomer shekkol mah shehaadam holek lischora, apillu yesh lo mezonot veholek lischora leharvacha, o sheholek lirot pene chabero — chashub hakkol debar mitzva leinyan zeh, shemmuttar lo lehaplig betok g' yamim lipne hashshabbat ap al pi sheyyitbattel meoneg shabbat, vegam ap sheepshar sheyyitztarek laasot melaka gemura beatzmo mippene piqquach nepesh, veeno chashub debar hareshut ella mi sheholek letayyel bilbad:

Hayyotzeim beshayyara bammidbar vehakkol yodeim shehem tzerikim lechallel shabbat, ki mippene hassakkana lo yukelu leakkeb lebaddam bammidbar beshabbat — asurim latzet tok g' yamim lipne hashshabbat, mittaam shennitbaer lemala. Ella im ken holekim lidbar mitzva, kegon laalot leeretz yisrael, sheaz im nizdammena lahem shayyara apillu beereb shabbat — muttarim latzet. Ulekattechilla yipsequ immahem lishbot beshabbat, veim achar kak kesheyyihyu bammidbar lo yirtzu lishbot — yekolim laleket immahem chutz lattechum apillu yoter mi"b mil, im mityorim mippene chayyot raot, o apillu im mityare mippene listim shello yigzelu mimmennu behema velo yukal laleket beraglayv, o im yiqchu mamono velo yukal lichyot od bammidbar, o im yiqchu malbushayv bizman haqqor kimat yamut biqrirut, kol echad meellu niqra piqquach nepesh, umuttar lo lelek immahem. Veyesh omerim kevan sheyyodea beberur gamur shebbevadday yitztarek lechallel shabbat — asur latzet apillu beyom rishon, apillu lidbar mitzva. Velo hittiru lidbar mitzva o qodem g' yamim shellipne hashshabbat ella lehaplig bispina, sheen sham vadday gamur sheyyitztarek lechallel shabbat, sheepshar kesheyyaggia hashshabbat yaggiu lenamal acher veyaamdu sham kol hashshabbat, vaazay lo yechallelu baasiyyat melaka, velo bitchumin, ap al pi sheen bammayim omeq y' tepachim. Ap al pi sheqqarob levadday hu sheyyitztarek lechallelo — heqellu chakamim qodem g' yamim, o lidbar mitzva apillu betok g' yamim, abal keshehu vadday gamur sheyyitztarek lechallelo — lo heqellu kelal beshum inyan. Veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem, abal en limchot beyad hammeqillin, hoil veyesh lahem al mi sheyyismeku. Vaapillu mi sheholek leeretz yisrael lischora velo kede lehityashsheb bah — en limchot beyado, lepi sheyyesh mi sheomer shezzehu gam ken debar mitzva, shehare ameru chakamim: "kol hamhallek d' ammot beeretz yisrael — mubtach lo shehu ben olam habba". Umikkol maqom, im holek betok g' yamim lischora o lirot pene chabero — yesh limchot beyado, hoil verabbu haoserim sheen zeh chashub debar mitzva kelal:

Vekol zeh lekattechilla, abal bediabad shekkebar yatza beshayyara apillu beereb shabbat, vaapillu letayyel, vehiggia lemaqom sheyyesh lo chashash sakkana lehippared mehashshayyara — yakol laleket immahem beshabbat ad sheyyaggia lemaqom sheen lo chashash sakkana lehippared mehem, vesham yishbot, velo yelek immahem. Vaapillu hu samuk lair lo yikkanes letokah, lepi sheen lo sham ella d' ammot, kedin hayyotze chutz lattechum. Veap im haya lo chashash sakkana ad shenniknas lair — eno rashshay lehallek bah yoter mid' ammot ap im hi muqqepet mechitztzot ledira, kevan sheyyatza shello birshut chakamim sheaseru latzet beshayyara tok g' yamim lidbar hareshut, vaapillu im yatza lischora o lirot pene chabero — hare zeh keyotze lidbar hareshut mammash leinyan zeh, kemo shennitbaer. Umikkol maqom, im yatza mechamat shello haya baqi bahalaka vehaya sabur shemmuttar latzet ap lidbar hareshut — muttar lo lehallek bekol hair vealpayim amma lekol ruach sebiboteha, kevan shebbitchillat yetziato lo yatza beissur bemitkavven, veachar kak keshehiggia hashshabbat haya bimqom sakkana, umah shehalak beshabbat chutz lattechum dino keyotze chutz lattechum kede lehatztzil nepashot sheyyesh lo sham alpayim amma lekol ruach, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"z. Lepikak, ap im qodem shehiggia lair lo haya lo sham chashash sakkana — rashshay likkanes lair im hu betok alpayim lair. Veen tzarik lomar im yatza behetter, kegon lidbar mitzva mammash, o qodem g' yamim, sheyyesh lo alpayim amma lekol ruach mishshehiggia lemaqom sheen bo chashash sakkana lehippared mehashshayyara:
